summary.text: Ripper Repinski is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 26A, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Repinski is a small business owner and former Winona city council member.

paragraphs.text: Ripper Repinski, listed by Ballotpedia as Aaron Repinski, earned a high school diploma from Cotter High School and an associate degree from Winona State University.

His career experience includes owning and operating two small businesses, working as a pilot for Treasure Island Casino's Spirit of the Water, and serving as a pilot and tow operator for Riverview Towing.
He previously served as an at-large member of the Winona City Council.
Repinski succeeded Gene Pelowski Jr. in District 26A and took office on January 14, 2025.

For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Health Finance and Policy, Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, and Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy committees.
